subject: 140/165 feedback_correct fields lack encouragement keywords
body:
gp-feedback-correct-contains-encouragement found that 140 of 165 questions have feedback_correct text with no encouragement keywords (nice, right, correct, great, yes, exactly, perfect, good, solid, spot on, nailed).

The voice guide says Marcus is coach-style and celebrates results. Correct feedback should feel like a coach cheering Kai on. Most feedback_correct currently reads as explanatory (e.g. 'The base is 2, the exponent is 3') rather than celebratory.

Recommendation: GD to audit feedback_correct against .voice-guide.md and recommend a template pattern. GR would implement. Only 25/165 questions currently have encouragement language.
